reasons.persona_fit: Speaks directly to small-business owners in a calm, pragmatic tone; respects all persona rules and correctly includes no sales CTA.
reasons.clarity: The argument is clear, logically organized, and immediately understandable with zero hype or unnecessary jargon.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, practical test (input, rule, output) and clear heuristic criteria for assessing workflows without overpromising.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly grounded in approved evidence and boundaries, correctly noting that scan-heavy PDF work is out of scope as a starting point.
